_about: Card packs (src/delivery/packs.js; the spec: BLUEPRINTS-NOTES.md 'Card packs', CHECKLIST item 115). Every number here is the owner's to tune. rarities: lowest to highest, with the colour a card shows. odds: the weight of each rarity for a plain slot (rolled among the rarities the pack's pool has cards of; a rarity with no cards in the pool is skipped and its share goes to the others). ladder: the rarity of a garage car's blueprint card by its star tier (gold / blue, tiers 1 to 5; null = no cards, the 1-gold starters); a car's own `rarity` field is read first (the promoted idea-lot cars: epic, or legendary); goldOneBlueprint: the card of a 1-gold BLUEPRINT car (evergreen, starts locked), which must be obtainable. featuredRarity: the rarity a featured card shows when its car has no `rarity` (event cars), never below epic. kinds: size = cards a pack; pool 'evergreen' = every card that is always in the pool (the garage cars by the ladder, the evergreen blueprint cars; never an event car, never a key), 'all' = evergreen plus Bespoke keys (the keys of the Bespoke key cars, cars.js `bespoke: true`, not owned yet); bespokeBlueprints: true = the Bespoke key cars' blueprints (Legendary, their `rarity`) are in the pack's pool too, in their rarity (never evergreen: a career pack has none; a special pack gets its event's as featured cards); atLeast = { rarity: n }: the pack holds at least n cards of that rarity or better (the last slots are rolled again to make it so); featured (special packs): upgradeChance = the chance each slot but the last upgrades; featuredChance = the chance EACH featured card is hit when a slot upgrades (each its own roll; one card a slot); the last slot is always a featured card and is the pack's Epic-or-better. career: which Career levels give a career pack the first time they are delivered: every = every nth level of the main list (the tiers in order, then the levels outside them, no races, no events), plus the ids in levels. events: what a special event gives: stage = a pack for each stage done the first time, prize = a pack with the grand prize (null: none). log: how many opened packs the save keeps (what each held).
